topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks introduce the lecture topic and outline the learning outcomes for comparing cancer therapies.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and systemic limitations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover traditional cancer treatment modalities alongside their associated systemic toxicities and mechanisms of drug resistance.

topics.label: Therapies exploiting intrinsic tumor vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine targeted therapeutic strategies that exploit specific cancer vulnerabilities, such as hormone dependence, cell cycle checkpoint defects, and DNA repair deficiencies.

topics.label: Oncogenic driver kinase inhibition and resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss small-molecule targeted therapies designed to inhibit hyperactive oncogenic kinases along with the resistance pathways that emerge against them.

topics.label: Antibody-based and cellular immunotherapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies that utilize antibodies and engineered immune cells to harness immune responses against tumor cells.

topics.label: Progress, future directions, and dilemmas in cancer management
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics reflect on the historical progress, clinical trial dilemmas, and future paradigms guiding modern cancer therapy and management.
